author: Thomas à Kempis
title: That we ought to deny ourselves, and to imitate Christ by means of the Cross

notes.text: (1) John xiv. 6. (2) John viii. 32. (3) Matthew xix. 17, 21. (4) Matthew x. 24. (5) John xiv. 21. (6) 1 Mac. ix. 10.

verses.text: My Son, so far as thou art able to go out of thyself so far shalt thou be able to enter into Me.
verses.modernizedText: My Son, to the extent that you are able to go out of yourself, you will be able to enter into Me.

verses.text: As to desire no outward thing worketh internal peace, so the forsaking of self inwardly joineth unto God.
verses.modernizedText: As desiring no outward thing brings inward peace, so forsaking self inwardly joins you to God.

verses.text: I will that thou learn perfect self-denial, living in My will without contradiction or complaint.
verses.modernizedText: I will that you learn perfect self-denial, living in My will without contradiction or complaint.

verses.text: Follow Me: I am the way, the truth, and the life.(1) Without the way thou canst not go, without the truth thou canst not know, without the life thou canst not live.
verses.modernizedText: Follow Me: I am the way, the truth, and the life.(1) Without the way you cannot go, without the truth you cannot know, without the life you cannot live.

verses.text: I am the Way which thou oughtest to follow; the Truth which thou oughtest to believe; the Life which thou oughtest to hope for.
verses.modernizedText: I am the Way you ought to follow, the Truth you ought to believe, the Life you ought to hope for.

verses.text: I am the Way unchangeable; the Truth infallible; the Life everlasting.
verses.modernizedText: I am the unchangeable Way, the infallible Truth, the everlasting Life.

verses.text: I am the Way altogether straight, the Truth supreme, the true Life, the blessed Life, the uncreated Life.
verses.modernizedText: I am the altogether straight Way, the supreme Truth, the true Life, the blessed Life, the uncreated Life.

verses.text: If thou remain in My way thou shalt know the Truth, and the truth shall make thee free,(2) and thou shalt lay hold on eternal life.
verses.modernizedText: If you remain in My way, you will know the Truth, and the truth will make you free,(2) and you will lay hold of eternal life.

verses.text: “If thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.(3) If thou wilt know the truth, believe in Me.
verses.modernizedText: “If you would enter into life, keep the commandments.(3) If you would know the truth, believe in Me.

verses.text: If thou wilt be perfect, sell all that thou hast.
verses.modernizedText: If you would be perfect, sell all that you have.

verses.text: If thou wilt be My disciple, deny thyself.
verses.modernizedText: If you would be My disciple, deny yourself.

verses.text: If thou wouldst possess the blessed life, despise the life which now is.
verses.modernizedText: If you would possess the blessed life, despise the present life.

verses.text: If thou wilt be exalted in heaven, humble thyself in the world.
verses.modernizedText: If you would be exalted in heaven, humble yourself in the world.

verses.text: If thou wilt reign with Me, bear the cross with Me; for only the servants of the cross find the way of blessedness and of true light.”
verses.modernizedText: If you would reign with Me, bear the cross with Me; for only the servants of the cross find the way of blessedness and true light.”

verses.text: O Lord Jesu, forasmuch as Thy life was straitened and despised by the world, grant unto me to imitate Thee in despising the world, for the servant is not greater than his lord, nor the disciple above his master.(4) Let Thy servant be exercised in Thy life, because there is my salvation and true holiness.
verses.modernizedText: O Lord Jesus, since Your life was constrained and despised by the world, grant me to imitate You in despising the world, for the servant is not greater than his lord, nor the disciple above his master.(4) Let Your servant be exercised in Your life, because there is my salvation and true holiness.

verses.text: Whatsoever I read or hear besides it, it refresheth me not, nor giveth me delight.
verses.modernizedText: Whatever else I read or hear does not refresh me or give me delight.

verses.text: “My son, because thou knowest these things and hast read them all, blessed shalt thou be if thou doest them.
verses.modernizedText: “My son, because you know these things and have read them all, blessed will you be if you do them.

verses.text: He who hath My commandments and keepeth them, he it is that loveth Me, and I will love him, and will manifest Myself to him,(5) and I will make him to sit down with Me in My Father’s Kingdom.”
verses.modernizedText: He who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him,(5) and I will make him sit down with Me in My Father’s Kingdom.”

verses.text: O Lord Jesu, as Thou hast said and promised, even so let it be unto me, and grant me to prove worthy.
verses.modernizedText: O Lord Jesus, as You have said and promised, so let it be with me, and grant me to prove worthy.

verses.text: I have received the cross at Thy hand; I have carried it, and will carry it even unto death, as Thou hast laid it upon me.
verses.modernizedText: I have received the cross from Your hand; I have carried it and will carry it even to death, as You have laid it upon me.

verses.text: Truly the life of a truly devoted servant is a cross, but it leadeth to paradise.
verses.modernizedText: Truly the life of a truly devoted servant is a cross, but it leads to paradise.

verses.text: I have begun; I may not return back nor leave it.
verses.modernizedText: I have begun; I cannot go back or abandon it.

verses.text: Come, my brothers, let us together go forward.
verses.modernizedText: Come, my brothers, let us go forward together.

verses.text: Jesus shall be with us.
verses.modernizedText: Jesus will be with us.

verses.text: For Jesus’ sake have we taken up this cross, for Jesus’ sake let us persevere in the cross.
verses.modernizedText: For Jesus’ sake we have taken up this cross; for Jesus’ sake let us persevere in the cross.

verses.text: He will be our helper, who was our Captain and Forerunner.
verses.modernizedText: He will be our helper, who was our Captain and Forerunner.

verses.text: Behold our King entereth in before us, and He will fight for us.
verses.modernizedText: See, our King enters before us, and He will fight for us.

verses.text: Let us follow bravely, let no man fear terrors; let us be prepared to die bravely in battle, and let us not so stain our honour,(6) as to fly from the cross.
verses.modernizedText: Let us follow bravely; let no one fear terrors. Let us be prepared to die bravely in battle, and let us not so stain our honor(6) as to flee from the cross.
